reports.title: MINISO Group Announces 2026 September Quarter and Nine-Month Unaudited Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue up 14.3% to RMB6.63bn, beat; adjusted EPS per ADS RMB2.36 vs RMB2.44, beat; no formal guidance

numbers.eps_basis: non-IFRS (adjusted) diluted per ADS (RMB; about US$0.35); IFRS diluted RMB0.96 vs RMB1.44

results: Revenue rose 14.3% to RMB6.63bn (about US$988m). MINISO stores in mainland China grew 29.6% on high single-digit same-store growth, the sixth positive quarter in a row.
Overseas MINISO revenue was almost flat (+1.7%) and TOP TOY revenue fell 12.5% to RMB502.5m.
Gross margin improved to 45.3%, but selling costs (ex share-based pay) rose to 25.9% of revenue from 23.0% as directly run stores expanded; adjusted operating margin ex-FX fell to 15.1% from 17.7%.
IFRS profit fell to RMB290.6m from RMB443.2m, hit by a RMB192.1m paper loss on a pre-IPO fund investment and a RMB155.1m derivative loss; adjusted net profit was RMB715.4m vs RMB741.4m.
Free cash flow was RMB463.2m; buybacks passed RMB1.0bn this year to 10 Nov, about 4.5% of shares. North America stores rose by 144 to 565.

guidance.summary: MINISO gives no numeric outlook. The CEO said he has "full confidence" in meeting full-year targets for the domestic business, but the release does not state those targets.

watch: Whether overseas sales pick up after a near-flat quarter, and whether costs of directly run stores keep squeezing margins.
Mainland China momentum into Q4: a preliminary October update showed China GMV up 20–25% in 1–7 October.
Large non-cash swings from the pre-IPO fund investment and equity-linked derivatives, which keep IFRS and adjusted profit far apart.
